name: per-tensor-quantized-sdpa-tile-zero-selector
rationale: Function constant 123 zeroes the input-type selectors. No per-tensor SDPA specialization accepts the resulting state, so the entry returns before resource or threadgroup-memory access; the one-lane exact observation remains unchanged.

name: sampled-background-uniform-texture
rationale: The loop-free fragment samples a one-pixel RGBA32Float texture at the generated float2 varying and multiplies it by an authored 0.5 fade; the uniform texel makes the sample independent of interpolation and address mode while the RGBA16Float attachment records the exact converted result.

name: planar-edge-alpha
rationale: The generated full-screen companion supplies the finite float2 texture-coordinate varying. The fragment converts it to half, evaluates its symmetric planar edge polynomial and AIR mix operations, preserves authored half RGB (1,2,3), and scales authored alpha 1 by the resulting exact factor.
